caption: The art of precision lies in texture: the grain of the wood, the roughness of the stone, and the patina of the walls, which tell an invisible story. You can almost feel the warmth emanating from the oven... a little secret kept by our solitary baker. #miniatureworld #diorama #handcrafted #tinyworld
